story.title: A dental clinic that grew into a family clinic
paragraphs: Dent Plus is led by Dr. G. Phani Krishna, a prosthodontist and implantologist who also teaches as a professor at Sibar Institute of Dental Sciences. The dental side is where the clinic's name comes from: restoring and replacing teeth with implants, crowns, bridges and dentures, alongside everyday dental care.

The 'plus' is the rest of the family. A family physician with paediatric training and a family physician with a diploma in ophthalmology consult here too, so a child's fever or an elder's blurred vision can be seen in the same building as a dental check-up.

Our tagline sums it up: your smile, our priority. The aim is simple, practical care for the people of Lakshmipuram and the rest of Guntur, explained clearly, with referral onwards whenever something needs a hospital.

items.title: Plain explanations
items.text: You hear what the doctor found and what the choices are, in words that make sense.
